Existing CGP handles downstream composition without a new macro. New _2 staging would add compiler/IDE and maintenance work without paying for four short constructors. refactoring_reviews.architecture_status: All eight required cells remain open; ordinary Genco/CGP reuse earns no _2 cell credit. The input getters and four short constructor paths do not justify a new staging framework.
refactoring_reviews.candidate: Exact-case IR actions/assertions require a compile-time Rust representation for the production core model checker.
refactoring_reviews.next_review_trigger: After the exact-case proof and input milestone, assess source-aware AgonesApiResource derive cross-crate hygiene in the next public API/resource feature, using the existing proc_macro2 expansion core.
refactoring_reviews.rationale: The existing runtime interpreter repeats 17 query assertions and now five input assertions; dynamic JSON is unsuitable for constant exact-case model checking. Reuse pinned Genco 0.17.10 already used by agones-rusternetes/build.rs for literal escaping and deterministic source emission. Add one narrow example consuming the existing typed IR and emitting only its five query cases, their source IDs, assertions and covers. Existing agones_invariant emits separate direct-Kani harnesses and an opaque boolean, without this metadata or the required shared backend route; it does not fill this gap. Arcane attribute/delegation transformation cores have no new role in emitting already typed literals. No new macro/staging/IR framework or semantic normalization is needed.
refactoring_reviews.roi: Five current cases/17 assertions and the next exact-case families otherwise require repeated handwritten harness edits, source-ID reviews and drift checks. A bounded emitter of roughly one small source file should remove that repeated work now and make exact selection mechanically checkable. Reuse escaping/formatting; keep semantic interpretation in existing typed IR and ordinary Rust. Validate deterministic output, source/gate freshness, all exact assertion IDs and nonempty covers. Stop at this family if production collection modeling dominates; keep adequate proof debt explicit rather than expanding a compiler framework.
refactoring_reviews.validation_plan: One deterministic Genco emitter, five source query cases/17 assertions, actual production core parser, shared Bolero/Kani harnesses with source-specific covers, and explicit unsupported environment/OS model boundaries.

refactoring_reviews.candidate: Replace private BTreeMap representation of small feature/default/query dictionaries with sorted Vec entries while preserving public behavior.
refactoring_reviews.next_review_trigger: After the production collection refactor and its exact-case proof, return to the next Agones production feature and assess source-aware derive hygiene at the next public API/resource milestone.
refactoring_reviews.rationale: The exact production query proof at unwind 64 is expanding standard-library B-tree node parent-link and comparison loops even though its fixture has only two features. The current diagnostic run is bounded to 240 seconds and will be retained regardless of outcome. Directly modeling a different map under cfg(kani) would not establish production semantics. A sorted Vec is an ordinary production representation for this small dictionary, preserving byte-sorted encoding, first query value, last duplicate default, atomic replacement, arbitrary names/bytes and unbounded accepted input sizes. It removes B-tree node machinery from both production and its model without reducing any source case, invariant, cover or declared bound.
refactoring_reviews.roi: One local container change in features.rs replaces three private BTreeMap operations; no new public framework, macro or backend is introduced. Validate all existing query/configuration/process/source tests plus duplicate-default and map-order edge witnesses. The concrete payoff is completion of the already generated 17-assertion production proof and simpler storage plumbing for the fixed 15 production gates. If this does not address the observed B-tree expansion, stop representation work and schedule the remaining adequately bounded proof; never reduce proof obligations to obtain a pass.
